title: QUIC RFC 9000 Migration Path Probing and Recovery Reset Verification
verification_method: Execution and inspection of the migration-aware path-probing runtime plus the requirement-home proof for the RFC 9000 Section 9 migration slice.
scope:
This verification covers RFC 9000 Sections 9.1 and 9.2 for the runtime-owned migration slice.
It checks that new local addresses remain candidate paths until path validation succeeds, that the runtime emits a protected PATH_CHALLENGE before treating the path as normal send traffic, that migration promotion resets congestion, RTT, ECN validation, and stale application packet state for real address migration, that port-only address changes retain congestion, RTT, and outstanding application packet state, and that recently validated application-data traffic stays on the current active path.
It does not claim a generalized multipath scheduler, public migration APIs, or broader recovery policy outside the migration promotion path.
expected_result: A new local address is probed before normal use, path validation remains explicit and protected, migration resets congestion/RTT/ECN validation state unless only the peer port changed, port-only promotion preserves outstanding application packet tracking, ECN revalidation restarts on the new path, recently validated application-data traffic stays on the current active path, and the requirement-home proof stays limited to the migration slice.
procedure: Run the requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P1-0001, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P1-0002, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0476, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0475, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P2-0003, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P2-0004, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P2-0005, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P4-0002, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P4-0003, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P4-0005.
Inspect the runtime path records and recovery snapshots for the candidate, validated, and active path transitions.

Confirm that promotion emits the reset path for non-port-only migration, preserves congestion, RTT, and outstanding application packet state for port-only changes, and leaves a recently validated path on the current active path when application data arrives.
preconditions: The RFC 9000 Section 9 requirement-home tests are discoverable by the test runner.
status_summary: This verification artifact records the landed Section 9 migration slice, including protected path validation before new-local-address use, migration promotion reset behavior, recently validated application-data deferral, port-only congestion/RTT/outstanding-packet retention, and ECN revalidation. The May 20, 2026 focused migration/path-state requirement-home filter remains the proof boundary; live rebind interop promotion is still tracked by the active inventory gap.
